column1: # One row per case, five tab-separated columns:
#   fixture   the envelope in fixtures/claude-review/, or `-` for a run that must be
#             refused before the engine is ever reached
#   args      what this case adds to `--base HEAD --level low`; a NAME=value word is
#             put in the run's environment instead (that is how a case reaches the
#             stub's stderr, its touch, or a non-zero exit). `-` for none
#   exit      0 a review, 1 a failure, 3 a reviewer that could not run
#   expect    fragments that must appear in the output, separated by `|`. Written out
#             per case on purpose: every failure prints the same first line, so a
#             status implies its line and checking one against the other asserts
#             nothing. What separates the branches is the advice underneath
#   note      what the case is there to hold
